name: Eggless Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and line 8 muffin cups; reserve a little flour to coat the blueberries.
Whisk yogurt, milk, sugar, oil and vanilla until smooth; sift remaining flour, baking powder and soda together.
Fold dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined; coat berries with reserved flour and fold in gently.
Fill cups about three-quarters full and bake for 22–26 minutes until a skewer is clean; cool on a rack.
tips: Fold frozen blueberries in directly without thawing to limit colour bleeding.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
